     # default ignore list for detailed views
     IGNORE = ('module', 'docuri', 'version_added', 'short_description', 'now_date', 'plainexamples', 'returndocs', 'collection')
 
+    _TTY_MACRO = re.compile(
+        r'(?<!\w)(?:HORIZONTALLINE(?!\w)|'
+        r'(?P<crossref>[LR])\((?P<label>[^(),]+),\s*(?P<target>[^()]+)\)|'
+        r'(?P<simple>[IBMUC])\((?P<value>[^)]+)\))'
+    )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tty_ify(cls, text):
+        def render(match):
+            if match.group('crossref') == 'L':
+                return '%s <%s>' % (match.group('label'), match.group('target'))
+            if match.group('crossref') == 'R':
+                return match.group('label')
+            macro = match.group('simple')
+            value = match.group('value')
+            if macro in ('I', 'C'):
+                return "`%s'" % value
+            if macro == 'B':
+                return '*%s*' % value
+            if macro == 'M':
+                return '[%s]' % value
+            if macro == 'U':
+                return value
+            return '\n-------------\n'
+
+        return cls._TTY_MACRO.sub(render, text)
+
     def __init__(self, args):
 
         super(DocCLI, self).__init__(args)

+# Copyright: (c) 2026, Ansible Project

+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat import unittest
+
+from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI
+
+
+class TestDocCLITtyIfy(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    def test_links_and_references(self):
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('L(label,https://example.com)'), 'label <https://example.com>')
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('L(label, https://example.com)'), 'label <https://example.com>')
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('R(label,reference)'), 'label')
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('R(label, reference)'), 'label')
+
+    def test_horizontal_line(self):
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('before HORIZONTALLINE after'), 'before \n-------------\n after')
+
+    def test_mixed_macros_and_plain_text(self):
+        text = 'Use M(name), B(text), C(value), I(note), U(url), R(label,ref), and L(site, https://example.com).'
+        expected = "Use [name], *text*, `value', `note', url, label, and site <https://example.com>."
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify(text), expected)
+
+    def test_parenthesized_words_and_unknown_macros(self):
+        text = 'IBM(International Business Machines) and X(text) plus prefixB(text)'
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify(text), text)
